title: Notification List
description: Fiori notifications with state icons, read/unread, importance, actions menu, close button, More/Less and collapsible groups with button or scroll growing (ui5-notification-list).

usage.summary: Collect business-event updates that users may read, act on or dismiss without interrupting their task.
useWhen: Keep users informed about relevant reminders, alerts or workflow updates they can revisit.
Group related events and distinguish unread state and importance so users can decide what needs attention.
Provide item actions or dismissal only when they are useful for the event.

avoidWhen.when: Confirm a completed action transiently without keeping an event collection.
Browse ordinary business items rather than event-triggered updates.
